import Mathlib

theorem final_dev_0110 (a b : Nat) (h : a ≥ b ∧ b ≥ 1) : a ^ b ≥ b ^ a := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0110 (a b : Nat) (h : a ≥ b ∧ b ≥ 1) : a ^ b ≥ b ^ a := by
  induction' b with b ih
  · have h1 : 1 ^ 1 ≥ 1 ^ 1 := by simp
    exact h1
  · have h2 : b ^ (b + 1) ≥ (b + 1) ^ b := by
      have h3 : b ≥ 1 := by exact h.1
      have h4 : b ^ (b + 1) = b * (b ^ b) := by simp
      have h5 : (b + 1) ^ b = (b + 1) * ((b + 1) ^ (b - 1)) := by simp
      have h6 : (b + 1) ^ (b - 1) ≤ b ^ (b - 1) := by
        have h7 : b - 1 ≥ 1 := by exact Nat.sub_pos h3 h.2
        induction' b with b ih
        · exact Nat.le_refl 1
        · have h8 : b - 1 ≥ 1 := by exact Nat.sub_pos h3 h.2
          have h9 : (b - 1) ^ (b - 1) ≤ b ^ (b - 1) := by exact ih h8
          have h10 : (b + 1) ^ (b - 1) ≤ b ^ (b - 1) := by
            have h11 : (b + 1) ^ (b - 1) = (b + 1) * ((b + 1) ^ (b - 2)) := by simp
            have h12 : (b + 1) ^ (b - 2) ≤ b ^ (b - 2) := by exact ih h11
            exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right h12 1
          exact h10
      have h13 : (b + 1) ^ b ≤ b ^ b * (b + 1) := by
        have h14 : (b + 1) ^ b = (b + 1) * ((b + 1) ^ (b - 1)) := by simp
        have h15 : (b + 1) ^ (b - 1) ≤ b ^ (b - 1) := by exact h6
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right h15 (b + 1)
      have h16 : b ^ b * (b + 1) ≤ b ^ b * b := by
        have h17 : b ^ b * (b + 1) = b ^ b * (b + 1) := by simp
        have h18 : b + 1 ≤ b * b := by
          have h19 : b * b = b * b := by simp
          have h20 : b * b = b ^ 2 := by simp
          have h21 : b ^ 2 ≥ b * b := by
            have h22 : b ≥ 1 := by exact h.1
            exact Nat.mul_self_le_mul_self h22 h22
          exact h21
        exact h18
      have h23 : b ^ b * b ≤ b ^ b * b := by simp
      exact h13.trans h16.trans h23
    exact h2
end Nl2LeanCandidate
